name: Illidari Intuition and Greater Illidari Intuition cannot both be active (#4718)
contract: Illidari Intuition (800212, +19 Agility) and Greater Illidari Intuition (680308, +76 Agility, raid radius) both apply SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT/agility directly to the target with no shared party-buff-slot aura id, and neither had a spell_group exclusivity entry: rev_20260909_05_felsworn_completion.sql's spell_group 1078 covers the differently themed Man'ari Intuition pair (523478, 523495) instead. rev_20260928_97_felsworn_illidari_intuition_exclusivity.sql adds a fresh group (1143, confirmed unused) with SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER (2), the same rule the Man'ari and Chronomancer Wisdom groups already use, so casting the second rank from the same caster replaces the first via Aura::CanStackWith rather than letting both sit on the target at once.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Clear the 1000ms StartRecoveryCategory 133 shared by both ranks before casting the second one
SETUP: Greater Illidari Intuition cast succeeded
DISCRIMINATING: Greater Illidari Intuition replaces the base rank instead of stacking alongside it
Greater Illidari Intuition is the one active rank
